brief: Today's posts centered on AI coding agents and harnesses, plus fallout from Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia and sovereign AI. Unsupervised Learning's emergency episode with Jordan Schneider covered the geopolitics, and Amjad Masad argued that token demand grows in step functions.

themes.label: Jensen Huang's Nvidia return
themes.summary: Builders framed Huang's return as a sovereign AI and US-China story, and debated how little predictions about it were worth.

themes.label: Agent harnesses and token demand
themes.summary: Builders described token use rising with each harness step, from autocomplete to swarms, and said adoption lags behind the tools.

themes.label: Antigravity and Gemini workflows
themes.summary: Peter Yang shared a free course on running Gemini with Antigravity, covering orchestrator swarms, a /grill-me skill, and remote control.

builders.name: Peter Steinberger
builders.summary: Reflected on a year of OC, saying it found a niche in prosumer and enterprise adoption and that the team now handles most of the work. Also noted a new memory system and an upcoming OpenClaw ID.

builders.name: Boris Cherny
builders.summary: Announced that MCP servers can now ship their own skills, so Claude Code can use them out of the box.

builders.name: Garry Tan
builders.summary: Argued that models have passed what some customers need, and that society has natural limits on how fast knowledge and business processes can change.

builders.name: Peter Yang
builders.summary: Published a free 17-minute Antigravity course on Gemini, with tips on multi-agent planning and remote control. Other posts were minor.

builders.name: Amjad Masad
builders.summary: Argued token demand grows in step functions with each harness step, and that sovereign AI demand matters beyond Nvidia. Also shared a 3B local Muse.

builders.name: Nikunj Kothari
builders.summary: Posted a list of 2026 pitches by company type, where each claims to control the universe. Other posts were personal.

builders.name: Guillermo Rauch
builders.summary: Explained that the coding agent CLI is a thin wrapper around libfx, aiming for an embeddable agent kernel. Also open sourced a bg effect builder.

builders.name: Unsupervised Learning
builders.summary: Released Ep 98, an emergency episode with Jordan Schneider of China Talk on the geopolitics of Jensen Huang's firing and return.

builders.name: Dan Shipper
builders.summary: Posts were minor, mostly short remarks and links, including a first prompt for new models.

builders.name: Aaron Levie
builders.summary: Argued that teams inside the same company now show very different output gains from AI, unlike past per-firm technology adoption.

builders.name: Thariq
builders.summary: Posted a single short remark, "you have to be bad at it for a while," which drew strong engagement.

builders.name: Thibault Sottiaux
builders.summary: Announced a banked reset and fast mode at no extra charge for ChatGPT Business teams through Dec 31, and promoted ChatGPT Business sign-ups.

builders.name: Swyx
builders.summary: Posted short reactions and a list of items from John on local-cloud environments, sandboxes, and dashboards.

builders.name: Matt Turck
builders.summary: Posted brief reactions, including a comment on Anthropic's valuation relative to its IPO price.

builders.name: Zara Zhang
builders.summary: Posted a brief note on product positioning and clarity, plus a short remark on visuals.

builders.name: Madhu Guru
builders.summary: Argued that confident predictions about the Jensen saga were poor signals of being right, and that the info ecosystem rewards certainty.
